pairs.target: zǎoshàng lái de cháng xiāng bǐshì yòng nà zhī shēn yì zhǎng , wàitou shuā zhe liǎngdào hóng qī , xiāngdǐ yě méiyǒu tóngyàng de sìtiáo cáo .
pairs.english: The long crate arriving that morning was a palm deeper than the trial crate, painted with two red stripes outside and without the same four base slots.
pairs.hanzi: 早上来的长箱比试用那只深一掌，外头刷着两道红漆，箱底也没有同样的四条槽。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi bǎ chǐ dǎkāi , sònghuò de rén yǐ jiāng chē tíng zài jiē fáng wài , shuō zuórì zài shānkǒu wèn guò , fēng zhàn jì yǐ huàn le tuōjià , jīnrì biàn búbì zài huā chāizhuāng de qián .
pairs.english: Before Tavi opened his ruler, the delivery driver had stopped outside the receiving office, saying he had asked at the mountain pass yesterday: since Wind Trestle had changed its cradles, there should be no more unpacking fees today.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没把尺打开，送货的人已将车停在接房外，说昨日在山口问过，风栈既已换了托架，今日便不必再花拆装的钱。

pairs.target: dù chéng jiēguò tā dì lái de zhǐ , kànjiàn zhuǎnyùn huì de yìn , liǎnsè biàn chén le .
pairs.english: Du Cheng took his paper and saw the transfer association's seal; his expression darkened.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄接过他递来的纸，看见转运会的印，脸色便沉了。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiān gǎn rén , zhī jiào chēfū jiāng chē nuó dào bù dǎnglù de qiángbiān , wèn zhè zhǐ cóng shuí shǒulǐ ná de .
pairs.english: He did not send him away, only asked the driver to move against the wall out of the road and asked who had supplied the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有先赶人，只叫车夫将车挪到不挡路的墙边，问这纸从谁手里拿的。

pairs.target: chēfū zhǐzhe zuì xiàmiàn yìháng , shuō jiāoqián de rén jiùshì zhào zhè xíng tì zìjǐ pái de lù , tiān méi liàng biàn cóng shàng zhàn xiàlái , bùnéng dào zhèlǐ yòu dāng méi shuō guò .
pairs.english: The driver pointed to the bottom line: the person taking his money had routed him by it. He had left the upper station before dawn; they could not now act as if it had never been said.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫指着最下面一行，说交钱的人就是照这行替自己排的路，天没亮便从上站下来，不能到这里又当没说过。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng xiě zhe cháng xiāng kě yóu tuōjià zhěngxiāng guò xiè guǐ , hòumiàn fùzhuó shíkè , qiánmiàn què méi le yǐ hé xiāngdǐ hé zhǐdìng qīngzǎi .
pairs.english: The paper said long crates could pass the unloading rails whole on cradles, with times attached, but omitted verified crate bases and specified light loads beforehand.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上写着长箱可由托架整箱过卸轨，后面附着时刻，前面却没了已核箱底和指定轻载。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng cóng xiá lǐ qǔchū yuánlái de shìyòng jìlù , liǎngzhāng bìng páifàng , zìjù xiàngshì cóng tóng yíchù chūlái , zhōngjiān piānshǎo le zuì yàojǐn de xiànzhì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng took the original trial record from his case. Side by side, the wording seemed to share a source, except for the missing vital restrictions.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡从匣里取出原来的试用记录，两张并排放，字句像是从同一处出来，中间偏少了最要紧的限制。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán xiǎngqǐ zuórì kànguò de tào xiāng , zǒu dào chēwěi , xiān kàn dǐmiàn , méiyǒu zài píng hóng qī hé chángduǎn rènzuò tóng yílèi .
pairs.english: Remembering yesterday's nested crates, Tavi went to the cart's rear and checked the base first, no longer treating red paint and length as proof of the same kind.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然想起昨日看过的套箱，走到车尾，先看底面，没有再凭红漆和长短认作同一类。

pairs.target: xiāngdǐ yìzhěngpiàn fēng zhe , zhī zài liǎngduān dīng le jiǎo mù , chéngzhòng de wèizhì yǔ yuánlái bùtóng .
pairs.english: The base was fully closed, with wooden feet nailed only at both ends; its load-bearing points differed from the original.
pairs.hanzi: 箱底一整片封着，只在两端钉了脚木，承重的位置与原来不同。

pairs.target: wēn xiù ràng tā tuì kāi , bǎ chá dào de qíngxíng xiě zài lìng yìzhāng zhǐ shàng , jì méi ràng rén dǎkāi jiājù , yě méi qù mō xiāngdǐ zhǎo yíduì néng jiè de tiě .
pairs.english: Wenxiu had him step back and write the findings on another sheet, neither opening a fixture nor feeling beneath the crate for iron to borrow.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫让他退开，把查到的情形写在另一张纸上，既没让人打开夹具，也没去摸箱底找一对能借的铁。

pairs.target: chēfū jiàn tāmen sāngè rén wéizhe zhǐ , shēngyīn yuèláiyuè gāo , wèn shìbushì zhè yìtóu shōu le qián , nà yìtóu biàn bú rèn .
pairs.english: Seeing three people gathered around paper, the driver's voice rose as he asked whether one end could take his money and the other refuse to honor it.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫见他们三个人围着纸，声音越来越高，问是不是这一头收了钱，那一头便不认。

pairs.target: jiē fáng wài yǐjīng yǒurén tíngbù , tǎ wéi shǒulǐ de bǎnzǐ chéng le zuì xiàng néng gěi gè shuōfǎ de dōngxī , yǒu gè tiāo kuāng de rén shènzhì tì chēfū wèn , xuégōng chūlái de hái tuī bú dòng yìzhī xiāng me .
pairs.english: People had stopped outside. The board in Tavi's hand seemed the likeliest source of an answer. Someone carrying baskets even asked for the driver whether an academy student could not push a single crate.
pairs.hanzi: 接房外已经有人停步，塔维手里的板子成了最像能给个说法的东西，有个挑筐的人甚至替车夫问，学宫出来的还推不动一只箱么。

pairs.target: tā hóulóng yǒuxiē fājǐn , xiǎng jiěshì búshì zìjǐ tuī bu tuī dé dòng , kāikǒu què xiān shuō chéng zhè zhī búsuàn .
pairs.english: His throat tightened a little. He wanted to explain it was not about whether he could push it, but first said this one did not count.
pairs.hanzi: 他喉咙有些发紧，想解释不是自己推不推得动，开口却先说成这只不算。

pairs.target: chēfū lìkè bǎ zhǐ jǔ dào tā miànqián , shuō shàngmiàn kě méi xiě zhè zhī búsuàn .
pairs.english: The driver immediately raised the paper before him, saying it did not say this one did not count.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫立刻把纸举到他面前，说上面可没写这只不算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐhǎo tíngzhù , chóngxīn gàosù tā , xiānqián shì de shì lìng yìzhǒng dǐmiàn hé yífèn qīngzǎi , búshì suǒyǒu cháng xiāng .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped and explained again that they had tested a different base and one light load, not all long crates.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维只好停住，重新告诉他，先前试的是另一种底面和一份轻载，不是所有长箱。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé màn le xiē , tīng qǐlái yě búzài xiàng ná yíjù huà dǔ huíqù .
pairs.english: He spoke more slowly, no longer sounding as though he were blocking someone with a single sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得慢了些，听起来也不再像拿一句话堵回去。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiēguò huà , ràng liǎng rén dōu xiān biétì nà zhāng zhuǎnchāo zhǐ tiān yìsī . tā chéngrèn zhǐ quèshí ràng chēfū bái gǎn le yígè zǎo shí , dàn bùnéng yīncǐ jiāng méi shì guò de dōngxī àn shì guò de sòng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng took over, asking both not to add meanings to the copied sheet. He acknowledged it had wasted the driver's early morning, but that could not turn untested goods into tested ones.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡接过话，让两人都先别替那张转抄纸添意思。他承认纸确实让车夫白赶了一个早时，但不能因此将没试过的东西按试过的送。

pairs.target: dù chéng jiào jìzhàng de rén hé le shōujiàn de xiānhòu , yuánlái nà yízhàn shōu de shì lù yùn de qián , tuōjià chāizhuāng zhèxiàng bìng méi yìtóng jiéqīng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng had the bookkeeper check the receipt sequence. That station had charged for road transport, without settling the cradle and unpacking charges together.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄叫记账的人核了收件的先后，原来那一站收的是路运的钱，托架拆装这项并没一同结清。

pairs.target: zhè bìng méi ràng chēfū gāoxìng . tā shuō bùguǎn qián jiào shénme , zìjǐ dōu yǐjīng fùchū qù , hòutou háiyǒu yítàng yào jiē , jīnrì búshì zuòzài zhèlǐ děng yígè hǎo míngzì .
pairs.english: That did not please the driver. Whatever the money was called, he had paid it and had another trip afterward; he had not come today to wait for a nice name.
pairs.hanzi: 这并没让车夫高兴。他说不管钱叫什么，自己都已经付出去，后头还有一趟要接，今日不是坐在这里等一个好名字。

pairs.target: wēn xiù zhàn zài pángbiān méi jiē zhège xiàohuà , zhī wèn xiāng lǐ shì shénme , ruò zhàojiù fēnkāi xiè , yuánxiān de lù néng bunéng zǒu .
pairs.english: Wenxiu stood nearby without taking up the joke, only asking what was inside and whether the original route could handle it unloaded separately as before.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫站在旁边没接这个笑话，只问箱里是什么，若照旧分开卸，原先的路能不能走。

pairs.target: xiāng lǐ shì fēncéng bāo hǎo de tóngguō . huòzhǔ gēn lái de huǒjì zhōngyú kāi le kǒu , shuō guō kěyǐ àn yuánlái de bànfǎ zhú zhī dì , xiāng què bùnéng liúzài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: Inside were copper pots packed in layers. The owner's accompanying assistant finally spoke: the pots could be passed individually as before, but the crate could not stay here.
pairs.hanzi: 箱里是分层包好的铜锅。货主跟来的伙计终于开了口，说锅可以按原来的办法逐只递，箱却不能留在这里。

pairs.target: tā pà zhòngzhuāng shí cā huā guō miàn , xiānqián cái tèyì wèn néng bunéng zhěngxiāng guò , bìng búshì xiǎng tōutōu sāi zhòng huò .
pairs.english: He feared scratching the pots when repacking and had specifically asked about whole-crate passage, rather than trying to smuggle heavy goods.
pairs.hanzi: 他怕重装时擦花锅面，先前才特意问能不能整箱过，并不是想偷偷塞重货。

pairs.target: dù chéng hé duìàn hé guò kòngwèi , gěi zhè yítàng lìng pái le chāizhuāng , jiāng guō zhú zhī zhuāngjìn huòxiāng , guò gǔ hòu yóu duìàn zhàojiù xiè chū , kōngxiāng lìng sòng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng checked space with the opposite bank and arranged separate unpacking: pots loaded individually into the carriage, unloaded across the valley as before, with the empty crate sent separately.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄和对岸核过空位，给这一趟另排了拆装，将锅逐只装进货厢，过谷后由对岸照旧卸出，空箱另送。

pairs.target: shíjì xiān guò de réng shì yuánlái hézhǔn de pǔtōng huò , búshì bǎ hóng qī xiāng yìngtuī dào tuōjià shàng .
pairs.english: Ordinary previously approved cargo still went first, rather than forcing the red-painted crate onto the cradle.
pairs.hanzi: 实际先过的仍是原来核准的普通货，不是把红漆箱硬推到托架上。

alignment.english: Ordinary previously approved cargo still went first

pairs.target: chēfū děng le bǐ zhǐ shàng xiě de gèng jiǔ , huǒjì qīnshǒu xiānkāi gécéng , kànzhe bān gōng bǎ dìyīkǒu guō dìjìn xiāng mén , cái kěn tuì dào pángbiān .
pairs.english: The driver waited longer than the paper promised. The assistant opened the partitions himself and only stepped aside after seeing the porter pass the first pot through the carriage door.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫等了比纸上写的更久，伙计亲手掀开隔层，看着搬工把第一口锅递进厢门，才肯退到旁边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài bǎn shàng xiě le kāixiāng de shíkè , yòu bǎ chēfū xiānqián nálái de zhuǎnchāo zhǐ jièlái , zhàoyàng chāoxià yífèn , lián nà liǎngchù kōng diào de xiànzhì yě zhùmíng .
pairs.english: Tavi recorded the unpacking time, borrowed the driver's copied sheet and made an exact copy, noting even the two omitted restrictions.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在板上写了开箱的时刻，又把车夫先前拿来的转抄纸借来，照样抄下一份，连那两处空掉的限制也注明。

pairs.target: tā běnlái hěn xiǎng jiāng wéiguān shí nàjùhuà yíbìng xiěxià , xiǎng le xiǎng , háishì zhī zài zìjǐ de xiǎo zhǐ shàng jì le , méi ràng tā biànchéng suǒyǒurén shuō guò dehuà .
pairs.english: He had wanted to record the remark from the crowd too, but after thinking, kept it only on his private scrap, without turning it into something everyone had said.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来很想将围观时那句话一并写下，想了想，还是只在自己的小纸上记了，没让它变成所有人说过的话。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , ruǎn héng qǐng dù chéng liúzhù yuánjiàn , chámíng nǎ yízhàn zhuǎnguò , xiān gěi yánlù fāchū míngquè de gēngzhèng , bié děng xià yíliàngchē yě ná zhe yíyàng de zhǐ lái .
pairs.english: That afternoon Ruan Heng asked Du Cheng to keep the original, trace its forwarding station and send a clear correction along the route first, before another cart arrived with the same paper.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，阮衡请杜澄留住原件，查明哪一站转过，先给沿路发出明确的更正，别等下一辆车也拿着一样的纸来。

pairs.target: shuí chāo lòu de , shìbushì zhī lòu le zhè yìzhāng , hái xū jiāng gèchù de běnzi nálái duì , yǎnxià bùnéng píng yígè yìn jiù bǎ yuányóu quán bǔqí .
pairs.english: Who omitted it and whether only this sheet was affected still required comparison of the stations' books. One seal could not supply the entire explanation now.
pairs.hanzi: 谁抄漏的、是不是只漏了这一张，还须将各处的本子拿来对，眼下不能凭一个印就把缘由全补齐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huí jiē fáng qǔshuǐ , jiàn zhuōshàng duō le yìfēng gěi zìjǐ de xìn . yīwén xiě lái , shuō shī nán yào dài tā yán jǐchù zhuǎnyùnzhàn kàn jiāojiē zìjù , fēng zhàn yě zài qízhōng , lièchū de dàodá rìzi qià shì sì rìhòu .
pairs.english: Tavi returned for water and found a letter addressed to him on the table. Iven wrote that Shinan would take him through several transfer stations to examine handover wording, including Wind Trestle; the listed arrival was four days away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回接房取水，见桌上多了一封给自己的信。伊文写来，说施南要带他沿几处转运站看交接字句，风栈也在其中，列出的到达日子恰是四日后。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi zhùchù nàtiáo jiē hǎobuhǎo rèn , zìjǐ bùxiǎng dìyītiān biàn zhàn dào suǒ lúndǐxià zhǎo yìzhāng chuáng .
pairs.english: He asked whether Tavi's street was easy to find; he did not want to spend his first day looking for a bed under the cable wheels.
pairs.hanzi: 他问塔维住处那条街好不好认，自己不想第一天便站到索轮底下找一张床。

pairs.target: tā xiào le yíxià , zhōngyú néng bǎ nà gǔ dǔ zài sǎngzi de qì yànxiàqù . zhǐ mò háiyǒu yìháng , shuō zhèhuí xiān gōngshì , bié yùbèi ná bàntiān dài tā táo gōng , tā rújīn duōshǎo yě suàn huì diǎnmíng de rén le .
pairs.english: He smiled, finally able to swallow the tightness in his throat. At the end was another line: business first this time; don't plan half a day of skiving with him, for he was now someone who could take attendance too, more or less.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑了一下，终于能把那股堵在嗓子的气咽下去。纸末还有一行，说这回先公事，别预备拿半天带他逃工，他如今多少也算会点名的人了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná qǐ huí xìnzhǐ , xiě kǎobǐng pù de mén cháo nǎlǐ , yòu zài pángbiān bǔ le yígè jídà de bǐng , xiǎng ràng yīwén dào shí bùnéng zài jièkǒu méi rènchūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi took reply paper, described which way the bakery door faced and added an enormous flatbread beside it, so Iven could not claim he had failed to recognize it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿起回信纸，写烤饼铺的门朝哪里，又在旁边补了一个极大的饼，想让伊文到时不能再借口没认出来。
